question: Whether random TU goals improve the first decision and its value estimate on far pairs earlier than S+1 does, what HER copies add over the same agent without copies, and how Mean value differs from Random goal, on stored per-pair test records without new runs.

definitions.post_hoc: Everything here is post hoc relative to the runs. It describes associations in stored rows, not causes.
definitions.pairs: The registered test block of every maze, every pair at the registered cap L, recorded weights checked equal within the maze; shortest distance d recorded per pair and checked against the maze geometry.
definitions.exact_distances: Every exact d is also tabulated, in JSON and CSV.
definitions.pooling: Within a maze each pair has equal weight. A pooled group view gives every pair weight 1 across the mazes of the group that have the checkpoint, so larger mazes contribute more pairs. Pooling happens within one arm, seed and checkpoint; seeds are never mixed.
definitions.truth: Q*(s, a, g) and V*(s, g) from acs2-maze-truth <maze> <L>, attached by per-pair-diagnostics analysis.attach (unchanged code, imported), which stops when the recorded distance and the recomputed V* disagree.

measures.F: first action in the optimal-action set of the capped truth, over non-fallback first decisions only (per-pair-diagnostics statistics_for F); undefined when a cell has no non-fallback decision
measures.fallback_share: share of pairs whose first decision is a random fallback, over all pairs
measures.value_error: estimated_first_action_value - Q*(s, chosen first action, g), over all pairs including fallbacks (per-pair-diagnostics values.all.estimate_minus_q)
measures.absolute_value_error: |estimated_first_action_value - Q*(s, chosen first action, g)|, same pairs
measures.overestimation: estimated_first_action_value > V*(s, g), over non-fallback first decisions (per-pair-diagnostics decision_metrics estimate_above_v)

interval.statistic: per seed: pooled measure of the left arm minus pooled measure of the right arm in the same group, distance bin and checkpoint; mean over seeds 42-46
interval.missing: a seed with an undefined measure makes the comparison undefined, reported with its count

counters.rule: Values as recorded in each row, per arm, maze and checkpoint, summarized over seeds. A field absent from an arm is reported as not recorded, never derived.

predictions.text: R - S+1 in F is positive on pairs of 5 or more steps at 30k and 100k, at lambda = 1/2 and 3/4.
R - S+1 in the signed value error is positive on pairs of 5 or more steps at 30k and 100k, at lambda = 1/2 and 3/4. The absolute error is reported beside it without a prediction.
R - S+1 in F is negative on pairs of 1-4 steps at 1k, 3k and 10k at lambda = 1.
S+1 - E+1 in F is positive on pairs of 1-4 steps at 1k, 3k and 10k.
R - M in F is positive on pairs of 5 or more steps at 30k and 100k, at lambda = 3/4.

criterion: A prediction cell is supported when the pooled mean difference has the predicted sign and its t(4) interval excludes zero on that side, contradicted when the interval excludes zero on the other side, and inconclusive otherwise, including an undefined cell. Each prediction is judged in every cell it names: 5 or more steps means bins 5-6 and 7+ separately, 1-4 steps means bins 1-2 and 3-4 separately. The report gives the count of each verdict per prediction.

source_selection.fixed_share: trajectory-utility-proportions grid_results.measured_sources: pilot, first submission and recovery from the sealed manifests
source_selection.references: E+1 and S+1 from the per-goal-reward-ablation local-full-index (six pyalcs mazes resolve to the per-goal-reward archive, 22 ALCS mazes to per-goal-reward-ablation); M and R at lambda = 1/2 from the trajectory-utility-measures registered full-index; both checked by the checksums the fixed-share analysis uses
source_selection.stop: Any run without complete per-pair test records on seeds 42-46 stops the analysis; nothing is substituted.
